name: The Professor
description: A portable Skill-suite plugin — scan a target repo, draft and maintain its documentation library, and keep per-section provenance, pointed at any repo, not just one handbook. The seven skills are the distributable unit, installable into whatever agent already exists; the bundled persona is an optional companion, not a requirement. Build state: Phase 0 is decided; Phase 1, the tools/professor.py tool layer, is built and hardened; all seven SKILL.md procedures are written; Phase 1b is filed and has not been started; Phases 2–7 are not built. PRD #2099 in launchpad-26/buzz is the live record of what has shipped.
